name: X11/Wayland Migration
description: Assists with X11/Wayland configuration when migrating from Docker to Podman dev containers. Does not install X11/Wayland runtime dependencies - those are host-provided resources.

setupDisplayVars.description: Configure DISPLAY and XDG_RUNTIME_DIR environment variables for GUI support.

documentRuntimeDeps.description: Output diagnostics documenting required host runtime configuration.
